scope: 10 assigned Magebean automation backlog requirements; source inspection only, no network/production scans

rows.rationale: An actionable remediation plan and explicitly reviewed alternative mitigation require a decision; OSV fixed-version metadata alone proves neither compatibility nor review.
rows.proposed_check: Report published fixed release candidates and optional read-only solver conflicts per detected advisory; do not assert an actionable approved plan.

tests.safe: All explicitly inventoried candidates meet the precise proposed check with complete known statuses. Verify applicable alternatives and exclusions explicitly.
tests.fail: One known violation of the precise proposed predicate fails even with missing statuses for other items; preserve redacted package/path evidence.
tests.missing: Missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, partial or unreadable input => UNKNOWN; never PASS.

rows.criterion: For each detected dependency vulnerability in the assessed lockfile, an actionable remediation plan must identify an available fixed package release or an explicitly reviewed alternative mitigation.

rows.rationale: Abandonment is an explicit package-maintenance status and can be machine-verified for a complete collected library inventory. Existing active MB-0061 already provides this for Composer libraries. Original full criterion can be satisfied only if all collected libraries are covered, including untyped/non-Composer libraries where present.
required_inputs: Per-package explicit abandonment status from dated authoritative source
Non-Composer library inventory if claiming all libraries
rows.proposed_check: Reuse MB-0061 for Composer libraries; inventory additional collected libraries with authoritative package identifiers and explicit known abandonment status for every item. Any unresolved identity or status prevents PASS.

tests.safe: All Composer and non-Composer libraries have explicit abandonment=false; missing package type must not hide a library.
tests.fail: One known violation of the precise proposed predicate fails even with missing statuses for other items; preserve redacted package/path evidence.
tests.missing: Missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, partial or unreadable input => UNKNOWN; never PASS.

rows.limitations: Conditional on complete collected library inventory and authoritative current per-library status. Merely filtering Composer type=library does not prove all libraries covered. This is overlap with an active check, not a net-new check for Composer-only deployments.
rows.criterion: No abandoned libraries allowed; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

rows.rationale: Risk can be an explicit machine-evaluable source policy: a complete mapping of replacements/forks/source overrides and exact approved upstreams/revisions permits a full verdict under that supplied policy. Current repository_trusted/is_fork heuristics and excluded missing sources are insufficient.
required_inputs: Complete lock plus root repository declarations
Canonical source URLs and pinned upstream revisions
rows.proposed_check: Enumerate all collected replacement and source-override candidates from complete lock/root repository declarations; resolve canonical upstream and source revision; reject candidates violating configured exact repository/revision risk policy. Unknown identity, fork state, unsupported provider or source must prevent PASS.

tests.safe: All explicitly inventoried candidates meet the precise proposed check with complete known statuses. Verify applicable alternatives and exclusions explicitly.
tests.fail: Root repository source override or fork revision violates exact source policy; unknown no-replace package source cannot be silently excluded.
tests.missing: Missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, partial or unreadable input => UNKNOWN; never PASS.

rows.limitations: Conditional FULL under an explicit technical fork-risk policy; cannot infer absence of undisclosed malicious commits. Root repository overrides, non-Git providers, missing statuses and all installed custom libraries must be accounted for. No current authoritative revision allowlist adapter is claimed implemented.
rows.criterion: No risky forks replacing upstream libs; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

rows.rationale: Regex detection of sensitive fields near outbound calls cannot establish business necessity, complete data flows, effective payload minimization or runtime interception; benign masked code can hide another export path.
required_inputs: Optional bounded representative outbound request fixtures
rows.proposed_check: Report inspected source locations with apparent raw sensitive fields in recognized outbound flows; label as suspicion requiring investigation, never proof all third-party flows minimize PII.

tests.safe: Masked recognized export yields no signal only; another unrecognized outbound flow cannot be asserted safe.

rows.criterion: PII minimization for third-party flows; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

rows.rationale: Source ACL/IP keywords do not prove effective integration privileges, endpoint access or least privilege. Business-required minimal permissions cannot be derived from code alone.
required_inputs: Applicable network policy API and named endpoints
rows.proposed_check: For explicitly named integrations, effective assigned ACL resources must be a subset of supplied allowed resources with no all-resource grant; separately verify named IP policy declarations through authoritative APIs. Do not claim optimal business least privilege.

tests.fail: Effective integration has all-resource or unauthorized grant; nearby ACL or IP keyword alone cannot PASS.
tests.missing: Missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, partial or unreadable input => UNKNOWN; never PASS.
